connector.name: pdfmux
connector.registryDescription: PDF-to-Markdown extraction that audits its own output and flags any extractor's silent drops.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package pdfmux. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nameetp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Google AI API key. Enables the paid Gemini Flash fallback for pages where all local backends report low confidence. pdfmux runs 100% locally without this.
